display_long_description:
Tiny worlds. Big putts.

Putt Planet is mini golf played with your own swing. The putter sits on your Touch controller and the ball rolls with the speed and direction of your stroke: tap it for a short roll or swing firmly to climb a ramp. You feel every hit in your hand.

THREE WORLDS, 20 HOLES
• Whispering Forest: 6 holes of sunny pines, a castle gate and a sky bridge.
• Frozen Peaks: 8 frosty holes shaped like the numbers one to eight.
• Golden Dunes: 6 holes with canyon jumps, dunes and a sandcastle.

STARS, MISSIONS AND REWARDS
• Earn up to 3 stars on every hole, 60 in total.
• Take on 3 missions per hole, 60 in all: hole in one, under par, no wall hits, beat the clock and more.
• Climb 13 player levels, from Rookie to Putt Planet Legend.
• Collect 8 ball skins and unlock 12 achievements.
• Finish a world to unlock its course tour: every hole in a row with a scorecard.
• Replay any hole; your best result is always kept.

COMFORT AND SETTINGS
• Teleport with the thumbstick, with an optional fade.
• Snap turn (30°, 45° or 90°) or smooth turn.
• The game can take you to your ball when it stops, or press A or X.
• Putter in your left or right hand.
• Height setting for seated play (up to +40 cm).
• Optional aim guide line.
• English or Spanish, switchable in Settings.

A wrist display on your free hand shows the hole, par, strokes and missions.

Single player, no internet needed. Progress is saved on your headset.
